newsitem.title: CANADA: Vancouver Feb cargo traffic up 3.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Vancouver Feb cargo traffic up 3.2 percent.

text.p: Vancouver International Airport handled 3.2 percent more cargo traffic in February on the strength of a 34 percent rise in freight moved through the airport by integrated carriers.
While passenger airlines handled 14,441 tonnes at Vancouver - 2.4 percent less than February 1996 - the integrators handled 3,584 tonnes, up from 2,872 in February 1996, the airport authority said.
For the first two months of the year, traffic carried by the integrators has risen 41.8 percent over 1996. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
